name: tandem-backend
description: Express backend skeleton for the Tandem live-commerce AI co-host demo.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/routes/agents.js && node --check src/routes/debrief.js && node --check src/services/debriefService.js && node --check src/lib/config.js && node --check src/lib/dynamoDb.js

dependencies.check: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
